a.text: The rain falls like tears, and I am but a single drop within this endless sea.
In this lonely night, I am no longer lost.

steps.name: Jailer
steps.text: Prisoner 48038, step forward.

steps.name: Excited Prisoner
steps.text: Sir! Your orders?

steps.name: Jailer
steps.text: Did you forget anything when going over your personal effects?

steps.name: Excited Prisoner
steps.text: No, sir, I made sure to check everything!

steps.name: Jailer
steps.text: Head straight down the corridor to the little window at the end and sign your name. You're free to go after that.

steps.name: Excited Prisoner
steps.text: Y-Yes, thank you, sir!
The sound of heavy jogging echoes down the corridor.
The heavy footsteps of boots gradually drew nearer, echoing down the hallway.

steps.name: Jailer
steps.text: Umiri.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: Here.

steps.name: Jailer
steps.text: Get lost. I don't want to see you again this year.
Umiri picks up her bass guitar case in one deft motion and strolls leisurely out of the prison.
Siracusa is much the same as ever, welcoming her return with an interminable drizzle.

steps.name: Lead Mobster
steps.text: Put our boys and girls in every shop on this street and the next ones over. Everyone keeps an eye out. We are NOT letting her run away!

steps.name: Cautious Mobster
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Nervous Mobster
steps.text: Just got news from North Street, boss! She's heading this way!

steps.name: Lead Mobster
steps.text: Keep your eyes on her! Don't let her run off!

steps.name: Nervous Mobster
steps.text: I... I don't think she's trying to hide, boss.

steps.name: Lead Mobster
steps.text: ...Get everyone back here, pronto!
In the narrow alleyway, a gang of ghoulish thugs surrounds the girl with the bass guitar case.

steps.name: Lead Mobster
steps.text: We meet again... Umiri.

steps.name: Lead Mobster
steps.text: Heh, and here I was wondering why a pro like you never got taken in by any famiglie.

steps.name: Lead Mobster
steps.text: See, after ours fell on hard times, I asked around, and that's how I learned you made your career out of being a traitor.

steps.name: Lead Mobster
steps.text: You've gone through a dozen names bouncing around every famiglia out there.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: Our contracts never said we couldn't do work for others.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: And like I said long ago: I only take my reward and fulfill the duties that match it.

steps.name: Lead Mobster
steps.text: Is that why you sold our secrets to our enemies?!

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: ...I don't know what you're talking about.

steps.name: Lead Mobster
steps.text: Don't play dumb, you goddamn traitor! Ever since you showed up, our people have been getting screwed left and right!

steps.name: Lead Mobster
steps.text: All thanks to me and the don being stupid enough to trust you. We even invited you to join us!

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: Francis, I don't remember what I've done to offend you all—

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: Hmph. What, you owe so many people you can't even remember?!

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: The don's dead, everyone's dead! We had hundreds of people, and now it's just our dozen left!

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: ...What do you mean?

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: We busted our asses moving from Columbia to this stupid place, but you had to go and get everyone killed!

steps.name: Angry Mobster
steps.text: No more talk. There's enough of us here to teach her a very painful lesson today!

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: I don't want to have to fight with you...
Umiri tries to stay the impending clash through words, but the gang shows no signs of relenting as they approach her—
She is forced to put her case down.

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: Alright... let's get her!

steps.name: Kind Old Lady
steps.text: I wouldn't go any further, now, bambina.

steps.name: Kind Old Lady
steps.text: Something just started up over there. You're not safe alone. Go the long way round, quick.

steps.name: Behatted Girl
steps.text: ...Thank you for the warning.
The girl pays the passerby's advice no heed. She continues on in the exact direction she was warned against.
The rain patters against the ground, washing Siracusa's every stain away.
The girl steps into the alley. It is clean and tidy, so utterly spotless as to seem newly built.
Siracusa's cleaners are consummate professionals.
Not the slightest stench of blood hangs in the humid air.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Umiri... where are you?
You... You looking for Umiri?
The billiards room of a casino. Nobody would expect someone to live here.
A few cardboard boxes are assembled into a makeshift bed. The most basic of toiletries fill a bag nabbed for free from a fast food joint.
The billiards table is covered in envelopes, envelopes containing Umiri's payment.
She opens them up one after the other, tossing the golden coins within onto the table. Soon, the pile of coins stamped with 'Famiglia' and 'Ordine' has become a miniature mountain.
And there the coins are left, out in the open, without the slightest protection. She wouldn't care the slightest bit if they went missing.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: ...Hmm?
Umiri checks over the envelope in her hand once more. There is nothing in it.
She flips it over. On its front is the insignia of a famiglia, along with the sender's address.

steps.name: Serious Mobster
steps.text: She's here, boss.

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: The guys in the prison didn't give you any trouble, did they?

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: They're all old friends. Besides, they know who my employer is. They wouldn't want to stick their hands in the fire.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: But I imagine you didn't summon me just to ask that, did you, sir?

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: Kheheh. Just concerned for a business partner, that's all.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: Sir, when did we become partners?

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: When you signed your contract with me, you wouldn't even use your famiglia's name.

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: Well, if you want to become 'partners', and I know you do, then let me lay my cards out—

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: Umiri, I'd like to have you for a long-term job.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: What kind of job requires us to meet face-to-face?

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: I'm thinking... of inviting you into the famiglia.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: What... did you say?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: There's nobody inside.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Why did you insist on coming along? You're obviously afraid of her.

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: You're not a mafioso, you wouldn't get it! I gotta... I gotta get revenge, for everyone's sake!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: What exactly happened between you and Umiri that you find so unforgivable?

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: If you ever got betrayed the way we did, you wouldn't forgive her either...

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: Our famiglia was mostly ordinary folk running away from the Columbian frontier. We didn't have much of a network or resources, so we've always been looked down upon by the local mafia.

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: Fast forward a couple of years, and one day, the boss decides to spend a fortune hiring someone.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: And that was Umiri?

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: Yep. Once we hired her, it was peace and quiet for a long, long time.

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: Those were the good days. Didn't have to worry about anyone raiding our place, or looking for trouble at our door...

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: But when we invited her to actually join the famiglia, she declined. Then the next day, she vanished. Just, gone.

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: And right as we started getting suspicious, a bunch of goons stormed in to stab us in the gut. No idea who sent them.

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: I still can't bear to look back at what happened that day... It was too much, too much!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: And you're under the impression Umiri sold you out?

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: Well, who else could it be?! You're crazy if you think it's a coincidence!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: ...I'm not willing to believe that Umiri would betray someone like this.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: The Umiri I know is much like you've described. Strong and capable, a reassuring presence.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: And always eager to uphold her duty as part of a group.

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: I mean, but facts are facts...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Did you see any trace of her amongst the people in that raid?

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: ...I did not.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Then do you remember what the raiders themselves looked like?

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: Can't forget for the rest of my life.
Sakiko takes a deep breath, moving her hand to the self-defense weapon in her pocket.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: What if... someone was deliberately trying to break you apart?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: What if... someone was keeping a close eye on Umiri this entire time?

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: ...What're you trying to say?
Before Francis can react, the cabinet doors all around them are thrown wide open.
Within each is a burly mobster, and all together, they raise their weapons at the pair in the center of the room.

steps.name: Mysterious Mobsters
steps.text: No funny moves.
